notes.title: Dungero launches on Steam Early Access!
notes.notes: [h1]Hello adventurers,[/h1][p]Dungero began its journey as a mobile roguelike RPG – and today we’re taking a big step forward: bringing it to PC.[/p][p]For us, this is not just a port. Early Access is our chance to transform Dungero into a [b]true PC experience[/b], shaped together with the community here on Steam.[/p][p][/p][h2]Why Early Access?[/h2][p]Moving from mobile to PC means more than a bigger screen. We want to refine controls, pacing, and overall game feel so it feels natural and fun on PC.[/p][h3]Early Access allows us to:[/h3][list][*][p]gather feedback from the community,[/p][/*][*][p]fine-tune gameplay balance,[/p][/*][*][p]expand content step by step,[/p][/*][*][p]improve transition from a free-to-play model to a premium PC experience,[/p][/*][*][p]build solid foundations for the full release.[/p][/*][/list][h3]What’s already inside:[/h3][list][*][p]the full roguelike core loop,[/p][/*][*][p]fast-paced dungeon runs with loot and progression,[/p][/*][*][p]heroes with unique abilities and playstyles.[/p][/*][/list][h3]During Early Access we plan to:[/h3][list][*][p]expand meta-progression systems,[/p][/*][*][p]introduce new curses, powerups, enemies, and environments,[/p][/*][*][p]polish controls and visuals for a smooth PC experience,[/p][/*][*][p]prioritize features based on your feedback.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Join the adventure![/h2][p]Dungero is now available on Steam for [b]$6.99/€6.99 with a 20% launch discount for the first two weeks[/b].[/p][p]By joining Early Access, you’ll help us evolve Dungero from a mobile prototype into a full-fledged PC roguelike.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey.[/p]
